notes: Department lists sourced from each state's own official portal (UP: up.gov.in/en/page/departments + Hindi mirror for nameHi, matched by shared domain, 73 depts minus 1 no-URL entry; UK: uk.gov.in/departments sector table + uk.gov.in/website/departments URL directory, merged/de-duplicated water-board entries and excluding non-departmental rows (High Court, State Election Commission, GMVN/KMVN tourism corporations); HP: himachal.nic.in's own department directory (58 rows) + officialUrl from himachalservices.nic.in, all fetched 2026-09-25). headPositionId is set from the EXISTING states-up-uk-hp.json ministers'/Deputy CMs' holder.notes (never redefined, only referenced) with token-overlap matching plus manual correction; where a portfolio is plainly GAD/Home/Finance/Planning/Personnel-cluster and the CM's own notes say 'and several other departments' (UP, UK, HP CMs all carry that phrase), it is attributed to the CM at confidence medium rather than left blank -- flagged per-relation via the 'basis' text. 20 of 184 departments could not be matched to any minister in the existing data (UP: Law, Panchayati Raj -- UP's own file notes a removed invented Panchayati Raj minister and explicitly says the true holder 'could not be confirmed and was not invented', so this segment follows the same rule; UK: Mines & Geology, Factories & Boilers Inspection, Labour, Employment, Energy, Solar Energy, Jal Sansthan, Peyjal Nigam, Law -- none of UK's 11 named ministers or the CM's explicit portfolio list cover these; HP: Advocate General [a Law Officer post, not ministerial], Election [Chief Electoral Officer function], Energy, Environment/Science/Tech, Fisheries, Forest, Information Technology, Tourism, Woman & Child Development) -- these are included with headPositionId omitted rather than guessed. Administrative-secretary positions (step 2) were only findable for Himachal Pradesh, via himachal.nic.in's own 'Administrative Secretaries' directory page (19 officers, IAS/IFS batch years, 45 department-secretary position records since several officers hold multiple department charges concurrently -- each gets its own position id per SCHEMA.md's one-seat-per-department rule). No equivalent single-page secretary/posting directory could be found for UP or Uttarakhand with the available tools (curl/WebFetch/python; this session's shared WebSearch budget was already exhausted by other parallel research agents before this sub-task started) -- per SCHEMA.md, omitted rather than guessed; a follow-up pass with fresh search budget against each state's 2025-2026 IAS posting/transfer-order lists would fill st-up-pos-secretary-<slug> and st-uk-pos-secretary-<slug>. Relations: every department with a resolved headPositionId gets a {minister/CM/DyCM -> dept, heads} relation citing the officialUrl or the matching method as basis; every department gets a {chief-secretary -> dept, oversees} relation since all three states' chief-secretary position ids already exist in states-up-uk-hp.json.

entities.name: Public Works
entities.description: Department of Public Works, Government of Himachal Pradesh: builds and maintains state roads, bridges and government buildings.

entities.name: Redressal of Public Grievances
entities.description: Department of Redressal of Public Grievances, Government of Himachal Pradesh: redresses citizen and public-service grievances against government departments.

entities.name: Revenue
entities.description: Department of Revenue, Government of Himachal Pradesh: administers land records, land revenue collection, disaster relief and the district/tehsil revenue courts.

entities.name: Rural Development
entities.description: Department of Rural Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh: runs rural livelihood, housing and infrastructure schemes (MGNREGA, PMAY-G, rural roads) in villages.

entities.name: Sainik Welfare
entities.description: Department of Sainik Welfare, Government of Himachal Pradesh: runs welfare schemes for ex-servicemen and their families.

entities.name: Secretariat Administration
entities.description: Department of Secretariat Administration, Government of Himachal Pradesh: administers the state secretariat's internal establishment and office procedures.

entities.name: Small Savings
entities.description: Department of Small Savings, Government of Himachal Pradesh: promotes small-savings schemes (post-office/NSC-type deposits) among citizens.

entities.name: State Audit
entities.description: Department of State Audit, Government of Himachal Pradesh: conducts internal financial audit of state government departments.

entities.name: State Taxes and Excise
entities.description: Department of State Taxes and Excise, Government of Himachal Pradesh: administers state GST, excise duty and liquor licensing revenue.

entities.name: Technical Education
entities.description: Department of Technical Education, Government of Himachal Pradesh: runs polytechnics and engineering/technical colleges.

entities.name: Tourism
entities.description: Department of Tourism, Government of Himachal Pradesh: promotes tourist destinations, hospitality infrastructure and heritage tourism.

entities.name: Town and Country Planning
entities.description: Department of Town and Country Planning, Government of Himachal Pradesh: regulates land-use master plans and building permissions for towns.

entities.name: Transport
entities.description: Department of Transport, Government of Himachal Pradesh: regulates road transport, vehicle registration, driving licences and runs the state road transport corporation.

entities.name: Treasury, Accounts and Lotteries
entities.description: Department of Treasury, Accounts and Lotteries, Government of Himachal Pradesh: operates the state treasury network that disburses government payments, salaries and pensions.

entities.name: Tribal Development
entities.description: Department of Tribal Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh: runs welfare, land-rights and development schemes for Scheduled Tribes.

entities.name: Urban Development
entities.description: Department of Urban Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh: plans and funds towns and cities: municipal governance, urban infrastructure and housing schemes.

entities.name: Woman & Child Development
entities.description: Department of Woman & Child Development, Government of Himachal Pradesh: runs anganwadi centres, child nutrition (ICDS) and child-welfare schemes.

entities.name: Youth Services and Sports
entities.description: Department of Youth Services and Sports, Government of Himachal Pradesh: runs youth-development, leadership and volunteering programmes.
